author: Ryan George Extra Plus!
description:
Taking care of your health just got easier – start here with my sponsor Zocdoc: zocdoc.com/RyanPlus

AI scam ads are selling impossible products, fake health transformations, and celebrity endorsements that never happened.

Hi there, hello.

Today I’m looking at the increasingly ridiculous world of AI false advertising. We’ve got bath bombs that apparently build entire civilizations in your tub, a jacket full of beer, and AI influencers selling health supplements. Finally, technology is solving none of our problems.

With help from HopeScope’s product tests, I’m comparing some of these AI-generated ads with what customers actually receive. Then we’re getting into fake Mark Cuban endorsements, supplement scams, and why these ads keep showing up on Facebook and TikTok. It gets considerably less funny when the consequences go beyond a disappointing bath.
